product_one_liner.value: Talowiz provides AI recruiting agents that automate candidate sourcing, evaluation, interviewing, and hiring workflows for recruiters and talent-acquisition teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage says Talowiz’s AI agents autonomously source, evaluate, interview, and select talent, with recruiters handling hiring. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists a Starter plan and its monthly price. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage contains customer testimonials from GoodGist’s CEO and Vedantu’s AVP HR describing their use of Talowiz. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/ | named_customers.0: GoodGist’s CEO describes hiring talent using Talowiz. | named_customers.1: Vedantu’s AVP HR describes the team’s use of Talowiz agents.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 15 employees, which maps to the requested 11-20 band. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/talowiz

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official privacy policy gives a San Jose corporate address, and the company profile explicitly identifies San Jose as headquarters. LinkedIn’s conflicting Ashburn listing creates some uncertainty. Sources: https://www.talowiz.ai/privacy-policy and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/talowiz/__V4vPXpp4iMqeXfNhyC1MQbWhedn204GFdweebE_XsPI | hq_country: The official website lists its office in San Jose, California, United States. This is preferred over the conflicting Ashburn location on LinkedIn. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/

founded_year.notes: Talowiz’s LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists 2022 as its founding year. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/76995163

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog index contains recruiting advice, product explanations, and marketing content rather than two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building Talowiz. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/blog

public_docs.notes: The reviewed homepage navigation and footer provide comparison, pricing, blog, contact, and legal links but no public documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The job-board page states that Talowiz had no open roles listed as of November 9, 2026. This supports no listed AI/ML openings, although an external board may not capture every vacancy. Source: https://www.thejobsmap.com/company/talowiz

model_provider.notes: The privacy policy explicitly says Talowiz developed a custom AI model to personalize behavior and content according to user persona. This identifies its own model, without asserting an undisclosed third-party foundation-model provider. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/privacy-policy

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Talowiz’s article describes SOC2 and GDPR features as built in and describes the offering as SOC-compliant. These are public compliance claims, not independently verified certifications. Generic ISO wording does not establish ISO 27001, so it is excluded. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/post/how-to-outsource-recruiting-without-losing-control | compliance_certs.0: The article names SOC2 features and SOC compliance; this is a public self-claim, not verification of an audit or certification. | compliance_certs.1: The article names built-in GDPR features. The wording supports a compliance-related claim, not an independently verified certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: PitchBook explicitly lists one completed Early Stage VC round, and CB Insights independently names FortyTwo VC as an investor. Other profiles report no known funding, so confidence is reduced; the explicit completed-round record is preferred over absence-of-data records. Sources: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/495789-58 and https://www.cbinsights.com/company/talowiz/financials | funding_date: The displayed completed round has a blank date field, so its month and year cannot be established. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/495789-58 | funding_amount_usd: The displayed completed funding round has a blank amount field. No dollar amount was publicly confirmed. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/495789-58

raised_18mo.notes: A completed venture round is listed, but its date is undisclosed. It therefore cannot be placed inside or outside the 18-month window, and conflicting no-funding profiles do not justify a negative answer. Source: https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/495789-58

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job-board page states that Talowiz had no open roles listed as of November 9, 2026, supporting no listed SDR, BDR, or account-executive vacancy. External-board coverage may be incomplete. Source: https://www.thejobsmap.com/company/talowiz

launched_6mo.notes: The reviewed blog index’s newest product-oriented entries are dated March 6 and February 25, 2026, before the six-month window. They explain existing hiring capabilities rather than announcing an in-window launch; the reviewed outsourcing article likewise describes capabilities rather than a new release. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/blog

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Available leadership histories were incomplete, and no dated C-level or VP appointment or departure could be verified within the requested window. The evidence does not support either true or false.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Talowiz explicitly states that it uses Mailchimp for newsletters and transactional emails and Google Analytics for website traffic tracking. These are direct marketing-stack usage disclosures. Source: https://www.talowiz.ai/privacy-policy | crm_stack_signal.0: Talowiz explicitly discloses using Mailchimp to manage newsletters and transactional emails. | crm_stack_signal.1: Talowiz explicitly discloses using Google Analytics for website traffic tracking.
